full_page.content:
1939, August 5
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solonus Case , 0.3.1.Cap.
Aug 5 1939
Kiss Winifred Goodwillie 416 Barry Ave. Chicago, Ill. Dear Miss Goodwillie: - God bless you and yours.
St. Bonaventure Monastery 1740 Ht. Elliott Ave Detroit, Nich
I just received your air favor and have inscribed you in the Seraphic Mass Association for your special Intent. Please God I hope things may brighten soon in regards to that same. However, and by all means shake off that anxiety of yours. Last year it was about something that now you smile about. To-day its about some thing that will not be serious if you raise your heart to God every time it comes to your mind and thank Him for whatever is to come.
Very Sincerely yours in Christ. Fr. Solanus, C.M.Cap
